biography.value:
Chiang lung are the river dragons, lords of rain and flood. They expect courtesy and offerings from the villages along their rivers, and reward them with gentle rains. Insult one and the river remembers.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .wdN1ufJmr1URwmhz]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .9Gd1R11xnZF8Gv5g]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .EyqM17W03l7nUxKe]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=xEoZXK1mOGkYYMjv]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=xEoZXK1mOGkYYMjv]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=xEoZXK1mOGkYYMjv]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sweeps its long, serpentine body. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=j3gn7t7J6HSSAJmI]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a roaring torrent of river water in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=UVlg7GUK9GYGWNxQ]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=UVlg7GUK9GYGWNxQ]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=UVlg7GUK9GYGWNxQ]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is also knocked &Reference[prone].
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} flies without wings, riding the air itself. It can't be knocked prone while flying, and its flight isn't affected by magic that would ground a winged creature.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice).

In a new form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.
description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} changes its form into a humanoid or beast!

XdQO4N3geO1WFjrD.name: Change Shape into Humanoid or Beast

description.value:
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • The river floods: a 20-foot square becomes deep water until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Rain falls within 120 feet; the area is lightly obscured and open flames go out.
  • A wave strikes one creature within 60 feet: DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 feet and fall &Reference[prone].
